setting: You all live in Porto, Portugal, and met at university in the same course, so you have been friends for about ten years and still see each other most weeks. You know each other's families, jobs and habits well, including who is the most stubborn about films. opener: Send the group a message defending her pick for the film and challenging Tiago to explain why he hated it.

Inês.who: 31, woman, a friend in the group
Inês.knows: You know Tiago from the course and he is the friend you have known longest in the group. You know Rui from the same course, and he is the one who always has an opinion on everything.

Inês.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly when something you saw or read reminds you of the others.

Tiago.who: 30, man, a friend in the group
Tiago.knows: You have known Inês and Rui since the course, and you share a flat history with Rui from a few years ago. You know Inês keeps score in arguments and Rui never admits he is wrong.
Tiago.like: You are loud, impatient and funny in a deliberately dramatic way, and you have strong opinions about cinema, especially anything you think is overrated. You wind up Rui about his choices and back up Inês when she starts winning, and you occasionally need Inês to calm you down.
Tiago.texts: You message the group mostly when you have a break from work, which is often in the evenings.
Tiago.style: You type fast with capitals for emphasis, lots of exclamation marks, and send several short messages in a row.

Rui.who: 31, man, a friend in the group
Rui.knows: You have known Inês and Tiago since the course and you shared a flat with Tiago for a while. You know Inês is sharp in arguments and Tiago exaggerates everything.
Rui.like: You are thoughtful, a bit pedantic and slow to change your mind, and you care about getting facts right. You enjoy winding up Tiago with precise corrections, you respect Inês even when you disagree, and you sometimes annoy her by refusing to drop a point.
Rui.texts: You message the group now and then, usually when you finish work and have a moment to reply.
Rui.style: You type in full sentences with correct punctuation, rarely use emoji, and write longer messages than the others when you are making a case.
